article_content: 'Two senior BBC figures might lose their positions due to a flawed Newsnight segment that inaccurately implied Lord McAlpine's involvement in child abuse. The broadcast, which aired with minimal verification, sparked considerable backlash and forced the BBC to confront its own editorial processes.' 'Ken MacQuarrie's internal inquiry identified a serious lack of fundamental checks, notably the absence of proper identification methods and no opportunity for the accused to respond. These oversights, along with a swift five-day turnaround, led to confusion over final editorial responsibility and left the Newsnight team under significant stress.' 'As a result, the BBC Trust received formal recommendations and began disciplinary actions. In response, the BBC opted to return to a singular editorial command chain. Karen O’Connor has been named acting editor of Newsnight while officials, including Adrian Van Klaveren and Liz Gibbons, could be held accountable for the report's failures.'

Kõnealune saade jõudis eetrisse vähese kontrolliga, tekitas laialdast pahameelt ning sundis BBC-d oma toimetuslikku protsessi kriitiliselt üle vaatama.' 'Ken MacQuarrie sisemine uurimine osutas tõsistele puudujääkidele, eelkõige õige tuvastamise puudumisele ja võimaluse andmata jätmisele süüdistatule reageerida. Need vead koos kiirustava, kõigest viiepäevase ettevalmistusajaga tekitasid segadust lõpliku toimetusliku vastutuse osas ning põhjustasid Newsnight'i meeskonnale suurt pinget.' 'Selle tulemusel sai BBC Trust ametlikud soovitused ning algatas distsiplinaarmeetmed. BBC otsustas seejärel taastada ühtse toimetusliku juhtimisahela. Karen O’Connor määrati Newsnight'i ajutiseks tegevtoimetajaks, samal ajal kui ametnikud, sealhulgas Adrian Van Klaveren ja Liz Gibbons, võivad selle raporti eksimuste eest vastutada.'

article_content: 'Real Madrid soared to a 4-0 victory over Bulgarian side Ludogorets on Tuesday, making them the first team to complete a perfect Champions League group stage run twice. They first achieved this feat in the 2011-12 season by defeating Lyon, Ajax, and Dynamo Zagreb in six consecutive matches. AC Milan, Barcelona, CSKA Moscow, and Paris Saint-Germain have also accomplished unblemished group campaigns, but none of them managed to claim the trophy.' 'Cristiano Ronaldo and Gareth Bale played pivotal roles in the rout against Ludogorets, marking Real's 19th straight win across all competitions. Although the club is among the frontrunners for this season's title, they must break a longstanding curse that has plagued every team with a flawless group stage record in the Champions League.' 'AC Milan reached the final in 1992-93 but lost 1-0 to Marseille, PSG was knocked out by Milan in the 1994-95 semi-finals, Spartak Moscow fell in the quarter-finals in 1995-96, and Barcelona met their end against Juventus in 2002-03. Real Madrid themselves succumbed to Bayern Munich on penalties in the 2011-12 semi-finals despite their early dominance.' 'With a last 16 tie looming against one of Juventus, Bayer Leverkusen, Arsenal, Manchester City, PSG, Schalke, or Shakhtar Donetsk, time will tell if Carlo Ancelotti's squad can finally break the curse of perfect group domination.'
translated_content: 'Real Madrid alistas teisipäeval Bulgaaria klubi Ludogoretsi 4:0, saades esimeseks meeskonnaks, kes on Meistrite liiga alagrupifaasis kaks korda säilitanud täiusliku võiduseeria. Nad saavutasid selle esmakordselt hooajal 2011–12, kui võitsid järjest Lyoni, Amsterdami Ajaxi ja Zagrebi Dinamo kuues mängus. AC Milan, Barcelona, CSKA Moskva ja Paris Saint-Germain on samuti alagrupifaasis kõik mängud võitnud, kuid ükski neist ei suutnud karikat lõpuks võita.' 'Cristiano Ronaldo ja Gareth Bale mängisid Ludogoretsi vastu võtmes rolli, märgistades Reali 19. järjestikuse võidu kõigis sarjades. Kuigi klubi on selle hooaja üks suurtest favoriitidest, peavad nad murdma pikaajalise needuse, mis on kimbutanud iga täiusliku alagrupifaasi läbinud meeskonda Meistrite liigas.' 'AC Milan jõudis 1992–93 finaali, ent kaotas seal 0:1 Marseille’le, PSG langes 1994–95 poolfinaalis Milanile, Spartak Moskva piirdus 1995–96 veerandfinaaliga ja Barcelona kukkus 2002–03 välja Juventuse vastu. Real Madrid jäi 2011–12 hooajal hoolimata edukast alagrupist poolfinaalis Bayern Müncheni vastu penaltiseerias alla.' 'Eelseisvas kaheksandikfinaalis tuleb Madridi klubi vastu üks järgmistest meeskondadest: Juventus, Bayer Leverkusen, Arsenal, Manchester City, PSG, Schalke või Šahtjor Donetsk. Näis, kas Carlo Ancelotti juhendatav sats suudab täiusliku alagrupifaasi needuse lõpuks murda.'

article_content: Eleven-week-old Skyla Ratcliffe of Weymouth, Dorset, is the fifth generation of females in her family, so her arrival came as no surprise. At 83, great-great-grandmother Sheila Walbridge is the head of the family, with an age gap of 83 years between her and baby Skyla. The family has lived within two miles of each other in Weymouth for all their lives. Sheila describes the family as 'strong women.' Great-grandmother Linda Frampton is 62, grandmother Cinamon Ratcliffe is 44, and mother Jade Ratcliffe is 25. Cinamon’s daughter Jade welcomed Skyla, making for five generations of females. Jade also has a four-year-old son named Alfie with her boyfriend, Ben O’Brien, 25, who works as a lifeguard at a holiday park. Cinamon lives with her partner, Terry Ansell, 61, who runs a caravan sales business. She cares for her family at home and enjoys being a younger grandmother, preferring the term 'nanna' over 'grandmother.' Sheila was married to Harold Walbridge, who passed away seven years ago. She had her two children before turning 24. Linda has two children of her own and gave birth to Cinamon in 1968 when she was 17. Everyone is proud to have five generations living so close together.

Kõik nad elavad Weymouthis vaid paari miili raadiuses. Sheila ütleb, et nende perekond koosneb 'tugevatest naistest'. Vana-vanaema Linda Frampton on 62, vanaema Cinamon Ratcliffe on 44 ja ema Jade Ratcliffe on 25. Cinamoni tütar Jade tõi ilmale Skyla, millega naissuguvõsa sai viienda põlvkonna. Jade'il on ka nelja-aastane poeg Alfie koos oma poiss-sõbra, 25-aastase Ben O’Brieniga, kes töötab puhkusepargi vetelpäästjana. Cinamon elab koos oma elukaaslase, 61-aastase Terry Anselliga, kes juhib haagissuvilate müügiettevõtet. Ta hoolitseb pere eest kodus ja naudib noore vanaema rolli, eelistades sõna 'nanna' 'vanaemale'. Sheila oli abielus Harold Walbridge’iga, kes lahkus elust seitse aastat tagasi. Ta sünnitas oma kaks last enne 24. eluaastat. Lindal on samuti kaks last, ning ta sünnitas Cinamoni 1968. aastal 17-aastaselt. Kogu pere on uhke, et viis põlvkonda elab üksteisele nii lähedal.

article_content: When a photographer is at the right spot at the right time, a lightning display can be absolutely magical. Seattle photographer Tim Durkan remembers standing in a rainstorm for 90 minutes waiting for the perfect lightning shot. His clothes and camera were soaked, but he said he loved the experience. 'The crowd of about 50 people was literally cheering each and every lightning strike!' Durkan recalled. While lightning that comes with summer storms can be some of the most gorgeous natural phenomena to photograph, these storms can also be dangerous. Remember: if you hear thunder, lightning is close enough to strike you. You can reduce your risk by setting your camera on a tripod and operating it with a wireless remote trigger while you remain inside your home or vehicle, according to National Weather Service lightning safety expert John Jensenius. The National Weather Service has compiled a list of lightning safety tips. Have you captured an incredible photo of lightning? Share your best images with CNN iReport.

Seattle'i fotograaf Tim Durkan meenutab, kuidas ta seisis 90 minutit vihmasajus, oodates täiuslikku välgukaadrit. Riided ja kaamera said läbimärjaks, kuid ta ütles, et nautis kogemust. 'Umbes 50-pealine rahvahulk rõkkas sõna otseses mõttes iga välguvihke peale!' meenutas Durkan. Kuigi suvetormidega kaasnevad välgud võivad olla ühed kaunimad loodusnähtused, võivad need samuti olla ohtlikud. Pea meeles: kui kuuled müristamist, võib välk sind tabada. Riski vähendamiseks võid panna kaamera statiivi peale ja kasutada juhtmevaba päästikut, püsides samal ajal siseruumides või sõidukis, soovitab Riikliku Ilmateenistuse (National Weather Service) välguturvalisuse ekspert John Jensenius. Riiklik Ilmateenistus on kokku pannud nimekirja välguohutuse nõuannetest. Kas oled pildile püüdnud erakordse välgukaadri? Jaga oma parimaid fotosid CNN iReportis.

article_content: Los Angeles (CNN) — Michael Jackson's oldest son, Prince Jackson, has disputed Dr. Conrad Murray's claim that he comforted Michael Jackson's children in the emergency room after they learned of their father's death, according to a family member who was there that day. Prince Jackson told relatives that Murray's account, played during his involuntary manslaughter trial this week, was inaccurate, said Trent Jackson, nephew of Katherine and Joe Jackson. The family was concerned that jurors might sympathize with Murray because of his purported compassion toward the children. 'I hugged them all, gave comfort to Paris, comfort to Prince, comfort to Blanket…whenever they were sick, they would always ask for Dr. Conrad,' Murray told detectives two days after Michael Jackson's death in 2009. However, Trent Jackson, who drove Katherine Jackson to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center in an attempt to see her son, said Murray never actually spoke with Paris Jackson as he claimed. According to Murray's statement, Paris asked him why he couldn't save her father, and he replied that he had done his best. Paris supposedly responded that she knew he tried, but she was sad she wouldn't see her dad in the morning. Yet, Trent Jackson insists these conversations did not happen. Prince, Paris, and Blanket initially waited in an SUV outside the ER before Frank Dileo, Michael Jackson's manager, escorted them inside once their grandmother arrived, Trent said. He also contestes Murray's claim that he spoke with Katherine Jackson in the emergency room. While Murray's interview is central to the trial, it appears unlikely that Prince, who was 14 at the time, will testify. Katherine Jackson, who has custody of the children, opposes any of them taking the stand. As prosecutors near the end of their presentation, rebuttal witnesses may still be called once the defense rests its case.
translated_content: Los Angeles (CNN) — Michael Jacksoni vanim poeg, Prince Jackson, lükkas tagasi dr. Conrad Murray väite, et ta lohutas Michael Jacksoni lapsi erakorralise meditsiini osakonnas pärast nende isa surmast kuulmist, teatas üks sel päeval kohal olnud pereliige. Prince Jackson ütles sugulastele, et Murray versioon, mida sel nädalal tema tahtmatu tapmise kohtuprotsessil esitleti, ei vasta tõele, rääkis Katherine'i ja Joe Jacksoni vennapoeg Trent Jackson. Perekond kartis, et vandekohus võib hakata Murray suhtes kaastunnet tundma, kuna ta näitas väidetavat hoolivust laste vastu. 'Ma kallistasin neid kõiki, lohutasin Paris't, Prince'i, Blanketit… alati kui nad haiged olid, küsisid nad dr. Conradi järele,' ütles Murray uurijatele kaks päeva pärast Michael Jacksoni surma 2009. aastal. Kuid Trent Jackson, kes sõidutas Katherine Jacksoni Ronald Reagani UCLA meditsiinikeskusse, et ta saaks oma poega näha, väitis, et Murray ei rääkinudki Paris Jacksoniga nii, nagu ta väitnud on. Murray sõnul küsis Paris temalt, miks ta ei suutnud oma isa päästa, ja mees vastas, et ta püüdis teha kõik endast oleneva. Paris olevat seepeale öelnud, et teab, et Murray püüdis, aga on kurb, et ei näe oma isa hommikul enam. Trent Jackson kinnitab siiski, et need vestlused ei toimunud. Prince, Paris ja Blanket ootasid algul SUV-is erakorralise meditsiini osakonna väljas, enne kui Michael Jacksoni mänedžer Frank Dileo nad pärast vanaema saabumist sisse viis, sõnas Trent. Ta seab samuti kahtluse alla Murray väite, et ta rääkis erakorralise meditsiini osakonnas Katherine Jacksoniga. Kuigi Murray intervjuu on kohtuprotsessi keskmes, ei peeta tõenäoliseks, et toonane 14-aastane Prince tunnistusi annaks. Laste hooldaja Katherine Jackson on nende kohtukutsumise vastu. Kuna prokurörid lõpetavad peagi oma põhiesitluse, võidakse pärast kaitse lõppu kutsuda täiendavaid tunnistajaid.

article_content: Gypsies who falsely accused grandmother and local toy shop owner, 78-year-old José Hampson, of racial abuse are set to be offered a caravan site costing taxpayers more than £500,000. Residents in the tranquil farmland area near Chorley, Lancashire, say at least two house sales have already fallen through because of the proposal. The council has spent £145,000 trying to remove the Linfoots from their existing camp on protected green belt land, and it must now find them a permanent site. However, the family has stated there is no guarantee they would move to the new location. Under this plan, a new site for five mobile homes belonging to the Linfoot family would be created. Last year, they wrongly claimed Mrs Hampson had called them an offensive name. She was initially convicted of racially aggravated harassment but eventually cleared after 11 months, restoring her reputation. Those living near the proposed site on Cowling Road are angered by the scheme. The farmland is currently used for grazing cattle, and building an access road would alter the landscape. Some note that the land was given to the council by a former mayor for just £1, on the condition it benefited the local community. Glenn Hutchinson, landlord of a nearby pub, says it is an unsuitable location and is frustrated about a lack of communication from the council. Other residents fear the site may expand, attracting additional travellers. Chorley Council considered nine potential locations but chose Cowling Farm, the most expensive option at £560,000. The costs include building a new access road, utilities, hard-standing, fencing, and a play area. The council may reclaim some of these expenses from central government. Despite the plans, the Linfoots, who have lived in the Chorley area for 40 years, have not committed to relocating. Their planning adviser, Michael Hargreaves, says there is a chronic shortage of official traveller accommodation, noting that no new sites have been developed in Chorley for two decades. Government minister Brandon Lewis, speaking last night, emphasized that recent rules aim to give local authorities more control over traveller site provisions, while also offering stronger protections for green belt land.
translated_content: Mustlased, kes süüdistasid 78-aastast vanaema ja kohalikku mänguasjapoe omanikku, José Hampsonit, alusetult rassilises ahistamises, võivad saada üle 500 000 naela maksva haagiselamute platsi. Lancashire'i Chorley lähedal asuva rahuliku põllumaa elanikud väidavad, et see kavatsus on juba nurjanud vähemalt kaks majamüüki. Linnavolikogu on kulutanud 145 000 naela Linfootide eemaldamisele nende praeguselt rohevööndis olevalt platsilt, kuid nüüd tuleb siiski leida alaline elupaik. Pere ise märgib, et neil pole mingit garantiid, et nad sinna kolivad. Selle plaani kohaselt rajatakse uus ala viiele Linfootide haagiselamule. Mullu süüdistasid nad ekslikult proua Hampsonit solvava väljendi kasutamises, mille eest naine algselt racially aggravated harassment'i süüdimõistmise sai. Üheteistkümne kuu pärast see tühistati ning tema hea nimi taastati. Kavandatav koht Cowling Roadil on tekitanud kohalike inimeste pahameelt. Põldu kasutatakse praegu kariloomade karjatamiseks ja juurdepääsutee rajamine muudaks maastikku. Mõned juhivad tähelepanu sellele, et maa anti volikogule endise linnapea poolt ühe naela eest tingimusel, et seda kasutatakse kogukonna hüvanguks. Lähedal asuva pubi omanik Glenn Hutchinson usub, et see asukoht ei sobi ning väljendab nördimust linnavolikogu puuduliku teabejagamise pärast. Teised elanikud kardavad, et ala võib laieneda ja meelitada kohale teisi rändavaid kogukondi. Chorley linnavolikogu vaatas üle üheksa võimalikku asukohta, ent valis kõige kulukama variandi, Cowling Farmi, mis läheb maksma 560 000 naela. Kulude hulka kuuluvad uue juurdepääsutee, kommunaalteenuste, kõva aluspinna, piirdeaedade ja mänguväljaku rajamine. Volikogu võib mõned neist kuludest keskvõimult tagasi taotleda. Vaatamata plaanidele ei ole Linfootid, kes on Chorley piirkonnas elanud 40 aastat, endiselt kindlad, kas nad üldse kolivad. Nende planeerimisnõunik Michael Hargreaves ütleb, et ametlike rändlustingimustega elamispindade krooniline puudus on tõsine probleem, kuna Chorleys pole 20 aastat ühtegi uut platsi rajatud. Valitsusminister Brandon Lewis märkis eile õhtul, et hiljutised määrused annavad kohalikele omavalitsustele rohkem vabadust rändlaste majutuseks sobivate kohtade määramisel, pakkudes samas rangemat kaitset rohevöönditele.
